name: Hydro / fire

request.text: Single pressurized water rifle shot. Immediate sharp compressed air crack with a wet high pressure liquid snap, tiny water droplets falling briefly. Punchy close dry game sound, no voice, no music, no echo, exactly one trigger pull at the beginning.
